MetaDefender Cloud Temporary Archive Processing Limit [resolved]
item.description:
Archive file processing will currently be limited to a maximum of 1,000 files per archive.
This temporary limitation has been implemented to help maintain service stability and consistent processing performance. Archives containing more than 1,000 files will not be fully processed.
Our team is actively working to restore normal archive processing capacity. We appreciate your patience and understanding and will provide an update when the limitation has been removed.

item.title: Resolved: Performance Degradation in MetaDefender Cloud Scan Result Delivery [resolved]
item.description:
Affected period: July 29, 2026, 06:00 UTC to July 30, 2026, 22:19 UTC
Between July 29 at 06:00 UTC and July 30 at 22:19 UTC, MetaDefender Cloud experienced a performance degradation affecting a small percentage of file submissions. Affected submissions remained In Progress longer than expected and were ultimately returned with an Aborted status. All other submissions processed normally.
Root cause: a configuration mismatch during the rollout of two new anti-malware engines caused scan-progress tracking to fail for a small number of submissions.
